Melody Typing — follows your current key/mode
A=Do S=Re D=Mi F=Fa G=Sol H=La J=Ti
⌨ Keys ON/OFFToggle melody typing on the Perform tab (button above the melody strip).
Z / XShift melody typing octave down / up.
Chords
1 – 7Play the diatonic chord for that scale degree (number row or numpad).
Shift + 1–7Play the 7th-chord version instead of the plain triad.
Playback
SpaceStart / stop everything (sequencer, bass, song) in sync.
Getting Around
TabStep through the controls on screen. The section bar at the top is the first stop.
← / →With the section bar focused: move between Setup, Mix, Songs, Accomp and Play. Home / End jump to the first or last.
Ctrl/⌘ + KFind any control by name and jump straight to it. Bare / does the same when you are not typing.
Ctrl/⌘ + ZUndo a sound-setting change. Add Shift to redo.
Song Navigation
NQueue the next song section (advances at the end of the current pass).
BQueue the previous song section.
Key & Mode — Perform tab only
↑ / ↓Transpose the key up / down a semitone.
← / →Cycle modes: Major → Minor → Dorian → Phrygian → Lydian → Mixolydian → Locrian → Harmonic Minor.
Performance Modifiers — while a melody note is sounding
Ctrl (hold)Accent the currently sounding note.
Alt / Option (hold)Roll — rapid retrigger at a 16th-note-triplet rate.

A setup is the whole app frozen exactly as it stands — tempo, key and mode, every voice and MōdSynth patch, the FX macros, the mixer, your drum, bass and melody patterns, the current chart and your whole setlist. Save one, and opening it again puts you back where you were, ready to perform.

Channels
Master peak holds for a moment
Master Bus
Master Vol
72%
Glue Comp
35%
Bus Reverb
18%
Glue compression rides the whole mix so the parts sit together instead of stacking up. Bus reverb is one shared room on top of each instrument's own send. A brick-wall limiter always sits last — Master Vol stays live even with the bus bypassed.
Export
Captures a .wav of everything you hear — post master bus, including Master Vol — plus a .mid of the exact notes played, so you can carry the take into a DAW. Both download when you stop.

Stems adds one .wav per part next to the mix. They are dry — tapped at each part's own bus, before the reverb send and the master limiter — so you can put your own space on them in a DAW. A part that never sounded is skipped rather than written as silence.

Not the same as ⏺ Rec in the transport, which captures the chords you play into an editable Song section that stays inside the app. Use that one to build a chart; use this one to get files out.
MōdRiff — Quick ReferenceReference

MōdRiff is a harmonic performance & composition tool. Tap chords to play, build songs in the Songs tab, shape your sound in Settings.
